verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents its own rule-based automation surfaces: a no-code Workflow Builder, and call-handling State-based Rules and Interaction Rules that act automatically on call events. The evidence is only navigation-level titles, so how deep or broad the trigger/action automation goes is unproven. Event notifications and subscriptions are a developer building block and earn no credit on their own. Missing for 10: documentation of Workflow Builder triggers, conditions and actions; evidence of rules beyond call routing (e.g., SMS or messaging events); hands-on or independent corroboration.
